name.description: Display name of the kind; defaults to its folder name.

from.description: Bound from the match context: `kind`, `instance`, `path`, `key`, `item`, `item.<field>`, `value`; for collections also `collection`; for nested ones `parent_key`, `parent`, `parent.<field>`.

prompt.description: Asked from a human at confirm time; this is the prompt text. Not allowed on AUTO actions.

secret.description: A secret reference, resolved by the server's secret provider only when the action runs — never stored, never logged.

required.description: Prompt inputs only: whether an answer is mandatory.

additionalProperties.description: One input: exactly one of `from`, `const`, `prompt` or `secret`. `~` (null) drops a kind default of that name.

inputs.description: Inputs appended to every action of the kind (capabilities and instance overrides) that doesn't name that input itself; `name: ~` on an action drops a default. Typically the one secret every playbook needs.

defaults.description: What every action of the kind gets.
